name: Emylcamate
effects: CNS and respiratory depression with alcohol/BZDs/opioids

mechanismOfAction.summary: Carbamate sedative-hypnotic; meprobamate-like GABAergic/barbiturate-like CNS depression with fast onset (carbamate chemical class). Mechanism incompletely characterized by modern GABA-A pharmacology.
mechanismOfAction.description: Carbamate ester anxiolytic and muscle relaxant developed by Merck (1961). Former brand names: Striatran, Striatal. Fast-onset CNS depression; meprobamate-class mechanism (GABAergic/barbiturate-like). Discontinued/obsolete. Additive CNS and respiratory depression with alcohol, benzodiazepines, and opioids. Overdose risk. Meprobamate-class control in many countries.
